title: Bacterial Genomics
text:
Overview
This course is designed for beginners who want to analyse whole genome sequencing data from bacterial isolates. Throughout the course we will introduce tools that are commonly used and basic requirements for analyzing any bacterial genomes. We will teach you how






TipLearning Objectives



By the end of this course, participants should be able to:

understand what the main technologies
use the unix and shell based command
